_purpose: Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. Written for an equipment builder that exports capital machinery, not for a shop that sells goods online. The client's instruction was explicit: protect the supplier, do not write it customer-first, and state only what is actually true.
_accuracyNote: The privacy text was written against what the site actually does, checked in the source: there is no form anywhere, no analytics, no advertising, no cookies. The only client-side storage is localStorage['theme'] set by the appearance toggle. If a contact form, an analytics tag or any stored submission is ever added, this file must be updated in the same commit that adds it - the page promises exactly that.
_reviewNote: Drafted in-house. A Taiwanese commercial lawyer should read both before they are relied on in a dispute, particularly the limitation of liability and the export control clause.
_lastUpdatedNote: ISO only, and the single source for the date. Each locale formats it for itself in build.ps1, so a Japanese page cannot end up showing an English date.

terms.heading: Terms of use
terms.lede: What this website is, what the figures on it mean, and when a price becomes a commitment. The short version: everything published here is for reference, and only a written order confirmation binds us.

sections.heading: Who these terms are from
paragraphs: This website is operated by Teamwork Automation Machinery Co., Ltd., an equipment builder registered in Taichung, Taiwan, trading internationally as FaTop Automation. Using the site means accepting the terms on this page. If they are not acceptable to you, please do not use it.

sections.heading: What the site may be used for
paragraphs: The site exists so that engineers and buyers can research our equipment and reach us. It may not be used to interfere with its operation, to reach any part of it that has not been published, or for any purpose unlawful where you are or where we are.
Bulk or automated extraction of the content - for republication, for resale, or for training a commercial model - is not permitted without our written agreement. Ordinary search engine indexing is.

sections.heading: Specifications are for reference, not a guarantee
paragraphs: Every capability figure, dimension, throughput number, description and photograph on this site is published for general reference. It describes what a class of machine is capable of. It is not a promise of what it will achieve on your part.

Motor production equipment is specified against a specific workpiece. Slot count, wire gauge, stack height, insulation class, tolerance and the cycle time you are working to all change what a given machine will do, and two customers asking for the same model can need materially different machines.
The specification that applies to your project is the one confirmed in writing during that project. That document forms part of the contract. Nothing on this website does.

sections.heading: What the photographs show
paragraphs: Machines are usually photographed as they were built for a particular customer, including tooling, feeders, guarding, transfer systems or automation designed for that job. Images should not be read as the standard scope of supply, and options visible in a photograph are not included unless they are written into your quotation.

sections.heading: Quotations and orders
paragraphs: A price, lead time or delivery date given on this site, in an email, or in conversation is an estimate. It is not an offer and it does not bind us.

A quotation becomes binding only when we issue a written order confirmation against a defined scope of supply. Until that confirmation exists there is no contract between us, and figures discussed beforehand remain subject to change with specification, material cost, currency and shipping.

sections.heading: Drawings and part data you send us
paragraphs: Drawings, samples, part data and production figures you send us in order to obtain a quotation stay yours. We treat them as confidential, use them only to evaluate and quote the work, do not publish them, and do not show them to other customers.

sections.heading: What belongs to us
paragraphs: The text, photographs, drawings, layout and code of this site belong to Teamwork Automation Machinery Co., Ltd. or are used with permission. Machine designs, tooling designs and process know-how remain ours whether or not they appear here, including where a machine was developed for a customer project.
Nothing published on this site grants a licence to any of it.

sections.heading: Links to other sites
paragraphs: This site links to material we do not control, including our Chinese-language website, our YouTube channel and third-party pages. We are not responsible for their content, their availability, or how they handle your data.

sections.heading: No warranty from this website
paragraphs: The site is published as it stands. We work to keep it accurate, but we do not warrant that every figure is current, that it is available without interruption, or that it is free of error.
Warranty for equipment we supply is set out in the supply contract for that equipment, and only there. No statement on this website extends, replaces or adds to it.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: So far as the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss arising from use of this site. That includes lost production, lost profit, and decisions taken on the basis of reference information published here rather than on a confirmed project specification.
Nothing in this section limits liability that cannot lawfully be limited.

sections.heading: Export control and end use
paragraphs: Our equipment is exported from Taiwan and can be subject to export control, sanctions and end-use rules in Taiwan and in the destination country. You are responsible for confirming that your intended use and destination are lawful.
We may decline an enquiry or an order where we are not satisfied on that point, and we do not have to give reasons.

sections.heading: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the law of the Republic of China (Taiwan). Disputes arising from them go to the Taiwan Taichung District Court as the court of first instance.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We revise this page as the site and the business change. The date shown below is the version in force. Continuing to use the site after a revision means accepting it.

privacy.heading: Privacy policy
privacy.lede: This website collects nothing. There is no form, no account, no analytics and no cookie. Enquiries reach us as ordinary email, and this page says exactly what happens to them.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: Teamwork Automation Machinery Co., Ltd., No. 46-2, Lane 53, Shengli 8th Street, Tanzi District, Taichung, Taiwan. Questions about anything on this page go to iverson.hsu@fatop-global.com.

sections.heading: What this website collects
paragraphs: Nothing. The site has no contact form, no account, no login and no basket. It runs no analytics, no advertising and no tracking scripts, and it sets no cookies.
There is nothing here that gathers your details, because there is nowhere here to submit them.

sections.heading: When you email or telephone us
paragraphs: Enquiries reach us directly, not through this website. What you send - your name, your company, your country, your contact details, and whatever you tell us about the part you need to produce - arrives in our company mailbox and is used to answer you and to prepare a quotation.
We do not build a customer database from website visitors. We do not add you to a mailing list you did not ask for. We do not sell, rent or trade contact details to anyone.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Enquiry correspondence is kept while the enquiry or the commercial relationship is live, and after that for as long as our accounting and warranty obligations require.

sections.heading: Your appearance preference
paragraphs: If you switch the site between light and dark, that single choice is stored by your own browser under the name theme. It is local storage, not a cookie: it never leaves your device and it is never sent to us. Clearing your browser data removes it.

sections.heading: Hosting
paragraphs: The site is served by GitHub Pages. Like any web server, GitHub receives the request your browser makes - which includes your IP address - and may log it for security and abuse prevention. That processing is GitHub's, under GitHub's terms. We have no access to those logs and we receive nothing from them.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask what correspondence we hold from you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Email the address above and we will answer.
Where a deletion request conflicts with an accounting or contractual obligation we are subject to, we will tell you which records we have to keep and why, rather than quietly keeping them.

sections.heading: If this ever changes
paragraphs: If we add a contact form, analytics, or anywhere for submitted data to be stored, this page is updated before that goes live - not afterwards.
